description: This file defines an enumeration called AttendanceType representing different attendance statuses for client meetings, including constants for invalid, present, absent, approved, leave, and late, along with methods to retrieve their associated integer values and codes, and a factory method to create an AttendanceType from an integer.

classes.name: AttendanceType
classes.description: An enumeration of client attendance status types with associated values, codes, and utility methods.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the attendance type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code representing the attendance type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Factory method that returns an AttendanceType corresponding to the given integer, or INVALID if the input is null or unrecognized.
